description: The University of Potsdam publishes a global inventory of glacial lake outburst floods assembled from 769 sources. Satellite and aerial imagery, official reports, scientific papers, news and other accounts contribute to the event database. Zenodo version 3.1 provides an OpenDocument spreadsheet of reported floods and a second spreadsheet defining the parameters and units. Access is public and free under CC-BY-4.0. The provider also links an interactive map for newer releases and previous versions. The exact event-date range is not stated on the inspected landing page. Uneven reporting and mixed evidence sources create uncertainty in event completeness and location accuracy. The inventory can support flood-hazard screening and historical checks for downstream hydropower, roads and settlements. It complements regional glacial-lake databases by combining reported events globally. The files were not downloaded and individual historical reports were not re-evaluated.
